authoring_policy: EveryNoise is used only for label membership. Nation/language labels are discovery umbrellas; each record documents one selected practice and period. All 13-axis integers, signal-chain components, exact instrument makes/materials, processing and tuning choices are authored relative catalog coordinates and reusable recording designs, not measured audio features or verified historical studio facts. chain_status is authored_contemporary_studio_model for every row.
membership_provenance: All five labels have status missing in the user-provided CodexMusica-genre-comparison.json. Their EveryNoise URLs are copied from that artifact. Direct EveryNoise map retrieval failed during this research; this dossier does not claim fresh artist-level membership verification.

This supports the duduk/melisma connection but not the exact authored roster or gear.

entries.scope: 2010s Dari-language commercial vocal pop with tabla and keyboard within Kabul/diaspora circulation
neighbor_distinctions: afghan_traditional is Kabuli/Hindustani-facing art music with rubab/harmonium and raga-derived forms; this is a concise commercial song with an electric backline.
persian_pop_los_angeles is a separate Tehrangeles lineage; the selected repertoire and tabla role keep this row distinct.
entries.configuration_rationale: Tabla and keyboard are supported at practice level by primary Afghan diaspora fieldwork. A small rhythm section plus foreground mixed-register vocal is an authored production reduction. Keyboard style-bank, fresh tabla setup, clean guitar and locked bass are sonic choices, not Aryana’s session inventory.
entries.geo_rationale: Kabul is a cultural/broadcast anchor and Aryana’s documented birthplace, not a claim that diaspora recordings are made there. South Asia follows the repository’s explicitly ruled Afghanistan bucket.
limitations: Instrument roster and processing are bounded authored reductions, not full session transcriptions.
Modern hardware/make, sample bit depth, retuning/reverb choices and numerical axes are not measured or historically attested claims.
Default preface scoring can select culturally remote vocabulary; rendered settings/pins are verified and the root integration owns signature review.

entries.scope: late-2010s Albanian-language producer-led electronic commercial single practice
neighbor_distinctions: albanian_iso_polyphony is multipart drone-based vocal practice; this row uses a foreground lead and programmed harmonic backing.

neighbor_distinctions: azeri_traditional models tar, kamancha, balaban and other regional acoustic practice; a national label alone cannot impose that roster on a crossover pop song.
The Armenian crossover default features a traditional reed and dance backing; this selected pop-ballad model uses piano/orchestral keyboard and gentler sampled rhythm.
